Thanks for the context, Diego. Quick legal read and next steps below. I’ve also attached a short PDF (Redline_suggestions_KPark_v1.pdf) with my inline language suggestions.

Key legal positions:
1) Notice window: cannot accept 10-day unilateral notice for new subprocessors. Standard is 30 days for non-emergency additions; 10 days may be acceptable only for operationally critical, pre-approved vendors and with prior written agreement.

2) Flow-down clause: require explicit flow-down of the DPA and Order Form obligations to the subprocessor, including data handling, retention, security standards, and breach notification timelines. Suggested clause (high level): "Vendor shall ensure any subcontractor agrees in writing to comply with Customer’s DPA and security requirements, including notification within 48 hours of any incident affecting Customer data." See attached for precise redline.

3) Indemnity carveout: do not accept a broad carveout for third-party telemetry processors. If EdgeOps wants to limit exposure, require explicit carveout language to be narrowly tailored (i.e., limited to third-party faults where Vendor can demonstrate contractual protections).

4) Evidence required prior to approval:
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (completed within last 12 months)
- Penetration test summary and remediation plan (last 18 months)
- Data flow diagram showing where Redwood customer logs would be stored/processed
- KMS/Key custody description (who holds keys; HSM/KMS provider)
- Subprocessor inventory and the contract template showing explicit DPA flow-down (redline of DataStream’s subcontracts if available)

5) Operational mitigations: require contractual commitments for log retention limits (default 30 days unless otherwise agreed), encryption at rest & in transit, and a maximum liability carveout aligned with Order Form caps.

Action items:
- Diego: please ask EdgeOps to accept the attached redline suggestions or provide counter-language for each of the bullets above.
- Marissa: confirm whether the proposed change to liability / pricing is material to the revenue math and whether we should flag for escalation.
- Laura: please prepare an evidence intake spreadsheet standard (I can share a template) and a one-page checklist for vendor onboarding.

I’ll hold off on formal legal redline submission to EdgeOps until we get procurement confirmation on commercial exposure.

—
Kimberly Park
